# CurrentUserResponse

Who the caller is (`GET /users/self`): their user, their tenant, and the roles this session or API key is authorised with.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `user` | [`User`](user.md) | The calling user. |
| `tenant` | [`CurrentUserTenant`](current-user-tenant.md) | The caller's tenant. |
| `roles` | `string[]` | The roles this session or API key is authorised with, such as `Tenant.Admin` or `Tenant.User`. |
| `isSuperAdmin` | `boolean` | Whether this session belongs to one of the platform's own administrators. Always false for an API key. |

  },

  ],

- [`users.self`](../api/users.md) (`GET /users/self`)
